senses.definition_en: to play the fool

examples.english: When I gave him a smacking kiss he played the fool 😔
examples.ref: 2019 October 10, @lisethland, Twitter, archived from the original on 10 Mar 2024:
examples.text: Cuando le tire un beso tronador se hizo el de los panes 😔
examples.translation: When I gave him a smacking kiss he played the fool 😔

examples.english: This goal shouldn't have counted, the offside is very clear. […] Bad refereeing, and luckily he refereed the penalty and didn't play the fool.
examples.ref: 2020 February 20, @reyalbo2011, Twitter, archived from the original on 10 Mar 2024:
examples.text: Este gol no debió de contar, muy claro el fuera de lugar. […] Mal arbitraje y menos mal que pitó el penal y que no se hizo el de los panes
examples.translation: This goal shouldn't have counted, the offside is very clear. […] Bad refereeing, and luckily he refereed the penalty and didn't play the fool.

examples.english: He played the fool and dodged the question, he didn't answer. Those who know about this scandal, leave your feedback 👇
examples.ref: 2023 October 2, @CAsturiasE46, Twitter, archived from the original on 10 Mar 2024:
examples.text: Se hizo el de los panes y evadió la pregunta, no respondió. Los que saben de éste chanchullo dejen su parte 👇
examples.translation: He played the fool and dodged the question, he didn't answer. Those who know about this scandal, leave your feedback 👇
